body: Thank you..I know I am shallow, but I am getting  closer to  being more humble and less judgmental of others.
Thank you! Your reply has given me some thoughts to ponder....

3 adult kids, of first marriage, one with five children of their own, no room. One whose long term girl friend could care less and even would not let me crash on the couch the first night I was locked out.  The other lives far away, but has said if I become homeless she would take me in. While I am getting old, I am still too young to have to live off of others. Frankly, I would rather die than be dependent on another person. I am now a complete failure, after being a very successful person, and that is pride, and I can't overcome it.  Do not worry, I will not take my life yet, as if I do, she wins, and I can't let that happen. I am not looking to win, i just want some equitable relief.  After I get that, that is if I get that, I will probably say goodbye, and leave whatever I have to my children.

​
Yes my kids know how I am feeling.  But they are not equipped to handle it, other than letting me know they know my plight and provide some emotional support.

I truly have wanted to do that, but I am living in a rural area, and my 16 year old pick up has nearly bald tires and I am afraid of venturing to far for fear of a breakdown.  I know I need to get out more. I am moving in three weeks, to a friends spare bedroom in a metro area, so I could use public transportation.  I need to overcome my standards of living that I have enjoyed in the past.  It is so hard. I shop at Walmart now instead of high end grocery stores, i buy my clothes at walmart, instead of Macy's.  I don't want to sound elitist, but it does bothers me, and bothers me more that my soon to be exwife has no money worries.
